decision: Use a stateless one-run challenge driver to bind dom0 and coordinator evidence collection before authoritative import.
scope: read-only Qubes Phase-1 deployment evidence freshness

winner.approach: cryptographically random one-run challenge + exactly-once collector invocation + existing importer
winner.correctness: One driver owns freshness generation and passes the same challenge to both independent trust domains, preventing deployment glue from accidentally mixing runs.
winner.robustnessSecurity: No persistent replay database, no privilege merging, no automatic retry after partial collector failure, and stale/cross-run output remains rejected by the existing importer.
winner.latency: Independent trust-domain collectors run concurrently; no additional qrexec protocol round trip is added by the evidence format.
winner.resourceUse: 24 random bytes plus two bounded exports; no daemon, WAL, database, watcher, or persistent process state.
winner.regressionRisk: Small orchestration layer reuses the existing exporter/importer contracts and does not alter MissionQueue, WorkerRuntime, qrexec mutation semantics, or readiness authority.
winner.qa: Tests cover entropy shape, same-challenge exactly-once delivery, stale/cross-run rejection, and fail-closed collector/entropy failure.

alternatives.rejectedBecause: Clock skew and replay windows weaken freshness and complicate cross-domain reasoning.
Adds lifecycle, corruption, recovery, locking, and privilege surface before real-Qubes evidence justifies persistent state.
Collapses dom0/coordinator trust separation and increases blast radius.

alternatives.approach: leave challenge generation to deployment glue
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Freshness remains a convention rather than an executable orchestration invariant.

failuresLessons: Freshness fields in exporters/importers are insufficient if no single run owner generates and distributes the value.
Exactly-once here means each collector callback is invoked once per driver run; it does not claim distributed exactly-once execution after host/process failure.
Collector failure is not retried automatically because a retry could create ambiguous mixed-run evidence; a new qualification run should generate a new challenge.
This gate remains synthetic/read-only and does not authorize state-changing Qubes workers.
safety: No real financial transactions, payment data, fraud workflow, or security-control weakening.
